events.name: app.opened
events.description: The app came to the foreground signed in.

events.name: onboarding.completed
events.description: Finished the first-run steps; value: time from sign-up.

events.name: first_action.done
events.description: First meaningful action (a message sent, a call or a channel joined); value: time from sign-up.

events.name: conversation.opened
events.description: A conversation opened; surface: where from.

events.name: search.performed
events.description: A search ran; results: how many came back, bucketed.

events.name: call.joined
events.description: Joined a call or voice room.

events.name: error.shown
events.description: An error message shown; code: the server's error code.

events.name: experiment.exposed
events.description: The person saw an experiment's variant (counted once per app start).

experiments.description: Home as one list of channels and DMs grouped by section (control) or as cards for each area first (cards).
experiments.successCriteria: More conversations opened from Home per active day, with no rise in searches for a conversation people already belong to.

experiments.description: New community members land in #welcome with a short checklist (checklist) or in the community's channel list (control).
experiments.successCriteria: A higher share of people who join a community send their first message there within a day.
